# Pincer Ops

> GitOps-driven Kubernetes platform for deploying and operating OpenClaw — an open-source, self-hosted AI agent runtime.

Pincer Ops bootstraps a production-grade local Kubernetes cluster using KIND (Kubernetes in Docker) with a full infrastructure stack: MetalLB for L2 load balancing, Envoy Gateway for Gateway API routing, ArgoCD for GitOps continuous delivery, Sealed Secrets for encrypted secret management, and cert-manager for TLS certificates.

## Quick Start

```
git clone https://github.com/PatrykQuantumNomad/pincer-ops.git
cd pincer-ops
make up       # Creates KIND cluster + deploys full stack (~3 min)
make status   # All apps should show Synced / Healthy
```

## Key Facts

- License: MIT
- Language: Bash scripts + YAML manifests (no application source code)
- Requirements: Docker, kind, kubectl
- Cluster: KIND multi-node (1 control-plane + 2 workers)
- GitOps: ArgoCD App of Apps pattern — `kubectl apply -f bootstrap/root-app.yaml` reconstructs complete cluster state
- Workload: OpenClaw Gateway (StatefulSet, single replica, PVC-backed at /home/node/.openclaw/)
